results.title: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking multimodal understanding across millions of tokens of context (arXiv:2403.05530)
results.snippet: Submitted 8 Mar 2024. Gemini 1.5 is described as using a mixture-of-experts (MoE) approach as a key architectural change from 1.0. The paper discusses the new architecture enabling a 1-million-token context window. No whitepapers were published for Gemini 2.0, 2.5, and 3. Authors: Petko Georgiev, Ving Ian Lei, Ryan Burnell, et al. (Gemini Team Google).

results.title: Gemini (language model) - Wikipedia
results.snippet: Key technical specifications extracted: - Gemini 1.0 Nano-1: 1.8B params, 32K context, distilled from larger Gemini models, 4-bit quantized - Gemini 1.0 Nano-2: 3.25B params - Gemini 1.0 Pro: Unknown param count - Gemini 1.0 Ultra: Unknown param count - Gemini 1.5 Pro: Unknown param count, 10M token context (1M in production API) - Gemini 3 Pro: Sparse mixture-of-experts (Sparse MoE), outputs up to 64K tokens - Gemini and Gemma models are decoder-only transformers with modifications for efficient training/inference on TPUs - 1.0 gen uses multi-query attention

results.title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models (arXiv:2312.11805)
results.snippet: Submitted 19 Dec 2023, last revised 9 May 2025. Author: Gemini Team Google (Rohan Anil, Sebastian Borgeaud, Jean-Baptiste Alayrac, Jiahui Yu, et al.). Training details: Gemini was trained on multimodal and multilingual dataset consisting of web documents, books, code, image, audio, and video data. Models are decoder-only transformers with multi-query attention. Gemini's dataset is multimodal and multilingual.

results.title: Google DeepMind - Gemini 3.5
results.snippet: Current model lineup: Gemini 3.5 Flash (latest, frontier performance for agents and coding), Gemini 3.1 Pro (best for complex tasks), Gemini 3.1 Deep Think (modern challenges across science, research, engineering), Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (high-volume tasks). 3.5 Pro coming soon. Models are decoder-only transformers. Gemini 3 Pro described as Sparse Mixture-of-Experts.
